$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: A snapshot naming another session is stale and rejected

rejection.rule: A snapshot applies only when sessionId matches the accepted connection session. A state naming another session is stale and MUST NOT affect the current session. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5, §6, §11)
rejection.effect: The phone retains the last valid projection and revision. The cross-session snapshot is harmless.

summary: After accepting session 333..., the desktop sends a revision-2 snapshot whose sessionId is a different session. The phone MUST NOT apply it.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: Valid revision-1 snapshot for the accepted session is admitted.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: sessionId names another session. The phone rejects the whole snapshot and retains revision 1. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5, §11)

outcome: Last valid projection (revision 1, session 333...) retained. A cross-session snapshot never affects the current session.
